answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require a refundable stake bond, locked like onyx in a vault: each identity posts collateral it forfeits if caught faking work. Newcomers start with a small timber-framed reputation that only grows through verified, attested jobs, while sable-blacklisted bad actors lose their bond. Faking a thousand identities then costs a thousand bonds, so the attack costs more than it pays.
